indication_area: Familial chylomicronemia syndrome (adjunct to diet); severe hypertriglyceridemia
geography: Worldwide (the issuer's total net product sales line for the product; launched in the U.S.)
moa: Antisense oligonucleotide (GalNAc-conjugated) reducing apolipoprotein C-III (APOC3) production

approval_evidence.quote: application_number NDA218614, brand_name TRYNGOLZA (AUTOINJECTOR), sponsor IONIS PHARMS INC, submission_type ORIG, submission_status AP, submission_status_date 20241219 (openFDA Drugs@FDA record)

launch_evidence.quote: With an encouraging start to the TRYNGOLZA launch for familial chylomicronemia syndrome, the first of four independent launches expected over the next two years (Ionis Q1 2025 release, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 filed 2025-04-30)

series_start_reason: TRYNGOLZA was approved 2024-12-19; the FY2025 10-K prints TRYNGOLZA sales for 2024 as '-', and the first printed quarter is Q1 2025, the launch quarter.
search_log: Listed every Ionis (CIK 874015) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions; scanned every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2020-07-01 to 2026-11-04 for 'tegsedi|tryngolza' (bin/scan.py).

10-Qs print 'TRYNGOLZA sales, net' in thousands; releases print it in whole millions. Q1-Q3 2025 and Q1-Q2 2026 from the 10-Q three-months column; Q4 2025 derived as FY2025 10-K 107,526 less nine months 57,353 = 50,173 thousand (release: 50 million).

Checks: six months 2025 6,287 + 19,273 = 25,561 and nine months 25,561 + 31,792 = 57,353 as printed; 2025 sums to 107,526 by construction; six months 2026 27,100 + 4,574 = 31,674 as printed; prior-year columns match. The 2026Q2 drop follows the April 2026 WAC reduction stated in the Q2 2026 10-Q.
